proposal.reason: Main change is in P2P transport IPC registration: it now registers/maps full multi-physical-segment buffers (not just first segment), carries segment counts through register/deregister paths, and adds segment-aware teardown for replay-safe cleanup. Add memory because allocation/map/unmap/free helpers in alloc.h were extended to segment-aware ownership and granularity validation, which changes deallocation semantics. Add network because proxy protocol/lifecycle behavior changed (batch FD query API, per-connection imported-handle tracking queue, and deregistration cleanup coordination), requiring proxy/UDS review.
